internship.title: React Native Development Internship
internship.description: A role-specific React Native Development Internship built around realistic assignments, detailed learning, practical work, validation, review and a final capstone.
internship.learningModel: learn -> inspect -> practice -> deliver -> validate -> review -> iterate
expectations: Complete every practical and dedicated task.
Follow professional quality and collaboration practices.
completionRequirements: Explain submitted work during final review.

modules.title: React Native onboarding
modules.description: Learn react native onboarding through realistic internship work. Students connect the concept to a real product/data problem, inspect existing work, implement or design a focused solution, validate it and prepare evidence for review.

lessons.title: React Native onboarding — Internship Lesson
lessons.description: Learn react native onboarding through realistic internship work. Students connect the concept to a real product/data problem, inspect existing work, implement or design a focused solution, validate it and prepare evidence for review.
learningObjectives: Apply it to the internship project.

notes.text: Learn react native onboarding through realistic internship work. Students connect the concept to a real product/data problem, inspect existing work, implement or design a focused solution, validate it and prepare evidence for review.

This is not a theory-only lesson. Treat the module like a real assignment: understand the requirement, inspect the existing project or data, make a focused change, validate the result, document decisions and prepare the work for review.

notes.alt: React Native Development Internship — React Native onboarding
notes.caption: Add a dedicated annotated visual, diagram, screenshot or data-flow illustration for React Native onboarding. The visual should teach the concept.

notes.text: First understand the problem behind react native onboarding. Then learn the relevant technique, apply it to the internship project, verify the result and explain why the chosen approach is appropriate.

items: Read the requirement or issue.
Inspect the current design/code/data before changing it.
Break the work into small steps.
Implement or design the solution.
Validate using tests, review, usability checks or data-quality checks as appropriate.
Check an edge or failure case.
Compare the result with acceptance criteria.
Document the result and limitations.

notes.code:
Internship scenario: React Native onboarding

Goal: Apply this skill to a realistic learning-platform requirement.

Workflow: requirement -> inspect -> plan -> implement/design -> validate -> review -> document.

items: Starting implementation before understanding the requirement.
Ignoring edge cases, empty states or data-quality issues.
Skipping validation or review.
Using inconsistent patterns instead of project conventions.
Submitting work without explaining decisions.
Keep work focused and reviewable.
Use consistent naming and structure.
Validate assumptions with evidence.
Consider accessibility, security, performance and reliability where relevant.
Document important decisions and known limitations.
I can explain React Native onboarding in my own words.
I can apply it to a realistic project problem.
I can validate the result.
I can identify an edge case or risk.
I can explain my decisions during review.

notes.text: Learn capstone: production react native app through realistic internship work. Students connect the concept to a real product/data problem, inspect existing work, implement or design a focused solution, validate it and prepare evidence for review.

This is not a theory-only lesson. Treat the module like a real assignment: understand the requirement, inspect the existing project or data, make a focused change, validate the result, document decisions and prepare the work for review.

notes.alt: React Native Development Internship — Capstone: Production React Native App
notes.caption: Add a dedicated annotated visual, diagram, screenshot or data-flow illustration for Capstone: Production React Native App. The visual should teach the concept.

notes.text: First understand the problem behind capstone: production react native app. Then learn the relevant technique, apply it to the internship project, verify the result and explain why the chosen approach is appropriate.

items: Read the requirement or issue.
Inspect the current design/code/data before changing it.
Break the work into small steps.
Implement or design the solution.
Validate using tests, review, usability checks or data-quality checks as appropriate.
Check an edge or failure case.
Compare the result with acceptance criteria.
Document the result and limitations.

notes.code:
Internship scenario: Capstone: Production React Native App

Goal: Apply this skill to a realistic learning-platform requirement.

Workflow: requirement -> inspect -> plan -> implement/design -> validate -> review -> document.

items: Starting implementation before understanding the requirement.
Ignoring edge cases, empty states or data-quality issues.
Skipping validation or review.
Using inconsistent patterns instead of project conventions.
Submitting work without explaining decisions.
Keep work focused and reviewable.
Use consistent naming and structure.
Validate assumptions with evidence.
Consider accessibility, security, performance and reliability where relevant.
Document important decisions and known limitations.
I can explain Capstone: Production React Native App in my own words.
I can apply it to a realistic project problem.
I can validate the result.
I can identify an edge case or risk.
I can explain my decisions during review.
